verdict.rationale: Moss has built-in keyword retrieval in the same index as semantic search. The core-concepts docs describe a hybrid mode tuned with `alpha`, where 0.0 means pure keyword. The GitHub README separately lists hybrid retrieval (semantic + keyword search), so no separate search engine is needed. Missing for 10: details on the keyword engine (e.g. BM25 scoring, tokenization, phrase or boolean query support), full-text feature docs beyond the alpha parameter, and independent or hands-on corroboration of keyword search quality.
